source: Self-hosted Scratch/TurboWarp fan game, 14 official Flipline standard downloads authorized for site hosting, and the specifically requested Sound Buttons Space destination. Official Flipline game icons are included alongside the hosted Papa's games.
attribution: Each title retains its source-specific attribution and licence/hosting notice.

games.title: Geometry Dash (Scratch)
games.description: A Scratch/TurboWarp-made Geometry Dash fan game, self-hosted in this repository. Not the official RobTop game.
games.attribution: Ajaykrishna Ramesh (AJ2130). See games/geometry-dash/LICENSE and ATTRIBUTION.md.
